'''Gold membrosia''' was one of the [[Killik/Legends|Killik's]] favorite nourishments. It was sold at the [[Restaurant Galatina]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for a thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per liter.
